items.title: CTO - Yang Chin-Yu
items.description: As per the business plan, Yang Chin-Yu is the CTO. Please add Yang Chin-Yu to the portal and upload the Personal History Disclosure Form and all enclosures (with the exception of source of wealth).

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Roles in Portal
items.description: As per the business plan, Fang Cheng Fan Wei is the UBO and the CEO. Please add the role of CEO for Fang Cheng Fan Wei in the portal.

items.title: Supplier License Application Form
items.description: Please correct the below errors on the Supplier License Application Form and resubmit the form. Question 3: This question was not completed. Please select all options that apply. If none apply, please provide an explanation regarding this. Question 4.3: The total number of games including variants must be entered. Question 18: Please enter the email address of the portal administrator as registered in the portal.

items.title: Business and Corporate Information Form
items.description: Please correct the below errors with the Business and Corporate Information Form and resubmit the form. Question 5: The date entered does not match the date of incorporation on the Curaçao Chamber of Commerce commercial register excerpt. Please enter the correct date. Questions 12 and 12.1: Please select 'Yes' for question 12. In question 12.1, please enter all those holding key positions even if the position is held by the UBO (CEO, CTO, CFO, etc.).

items.title: goAML Registration
items.description: Please note that the proof of goAML registration is missing. Kindly submit a screenshot of the admin page when logged in to the goAML portal. To do this, log in to the goAML portal, click Admin, select Active Organizations and take a screenshot of the page. Please upload the screenshot in the Extra Documentation section.

items.title: Source of Funds of Business
items.description: Please provide a certified copy of the loan agreement that outlines the key terms, including the funding, any interest on the loan and the repayment terms (if applicable). The loan agreement must be signed by all parties and certified. Kindly upload it in the Source of Funding Section.

items.title: Declaration of Good Standing
items.description: Please provide the Declaration of Good Standing (verzoek verklaring betalingsgedrag) of Apex Gaming International N.V. Kindly upload the document in the Extra Documentation section and name the file Declaration of Good Standing. Please note that the Declaration of Good Standing must be the official document issued by the Tax Authorities with the stamp of 'ontvanger' and the 'invorderaar' and it must be certified as a true copy.

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Personal History Disclosure Form
items.description: Please correct the below errors on the Personal History Disclosure Form and resubmit the form. Question 4: The Costa Rica naturalization certificate submitted with the birth certificate documents and the criminal record from Costa Rica documents indicate that Fang Cheng Fan Wei has an alias (Fabio Fan Wei). If this is correct, please add this information in question 4. Question 27: As per the business plan, Fang Cheng Fan Wei is the UBO and the CEO. If this is correct, in question 27 the 'Other Key Function Holder' box must be checked and 'CEO' added in the corresponding field. Questions 34 - 39: It is indicated that Fang Cheng Fan Wei is retired and no current employment is listed. If Fang Cheng Fan Wei is currently employed as the CEO of Apex Gaming International N.V., this must be indicated in questions 34 - 39. Declaration and Data Privacy: It appears that the signature is copy/pasted. Please note that copy/pasted signatures are not accepted. Please sign the form digitally.

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Birth Certificate
items.description: Please note that the documents submitted for the birth certificate cannot be accepted. Please note that all documents submitted for this requirement must be certified as a true copy by an independent and authorized certifier. In addition, any documents not in English must be accompanied by an English translation certified by the translator. Please submit a certified copy of the birth certificate.

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Passport
items.description: Please note that the certifier's statement certifying the document as a true copy must be in English, or an English translation certified by the translator must be provided. In addition, please provide a color copy of the passport.

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Costa Rica Criminal Record
items.description: The criminal record submitted for Costa Rica was issued more than six months ago and cannot be accepted. Please submit a certified criminal record for Costa Rica issued within the last six months.

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Bank Reference Letter
items.description: The bank reference letter submitted cannot be accepted because it was issued more than six months ago. Please submit a certified bank reference letter issued within the last six months.

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Proof of Address
items.description: Please submit an English translation (certified by the translator) of the proof of address document.

items.title: Kevin Goncalves Segredo - Passport
items.description: Please upload a certified true copy of the passport of Kevin Goncalves Segredo in the base application QPA/2024/02791.

items.title: Business Plan
items.description: Resubmit the 3 year financial forecast as an annex to the business plan, providing a detailed break down of any investments, revenue and OPEX, including any loan repayments/marketing expenses/wages. Submit the forecasts in the format of a balance sheet and income statement

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Source of Wealth
items.description: Please provide a certified copy of a bank statement. The bank statement must have been issued within the last six months and must be certified as a true copy. If the bank statement is not an English, an English translation (certified by the translator) must also be submitted.

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Proof of Employment
items.description: Please submit proof of the current employment as CEO of Apex Gaming International N.V. All documents submitted must be certified as a true copy.

items.title: Kevin Goncalves Segredo - Passport
items.description: Please upload a certified true copy of the passport of Kevin Goncalves Segredo in the base application QPA/2024/02791.

items.title: Fang Cheng Fan Wei - Birth Certificate
items.description: Please note that the documents submitted for the birth certificate cannot be accepted. Please note that all documents submitted for this requirement must be certified as a true copy by an independent and authorized certifier. In addition, any documents not in English must be accompanied by an English translation certified by the translator. Please submit a certified copy of the birth certificate.
items.notes: [Sent by Kevin Goncalves Segredo - 02-04-2026 15:10] Please note that in Taiwan, official civil status records such as birth information are issued through the Household Registration system by the government. The document provided is an official extract issued by the Household Registration Office in New Taipei City, and it is already issued in English by the competent authority. For your reference, we have included the certification section of the document, which confirms that it has been issued by the relevant government office. Given that this is an original government-issued document (not a copy), we kindly ask you to confirm whether this format would be acceptable. Alternatively, if a separate certification of true copy is strictly required, please let us know the preferred form of certification so we can arrange this accordingly. We trust this clarifies the nature of the document, but remain at your disposal should you require any additional supporting documentation. [Sent by Kevin Goncalves Segredo - 24-03-2026 17:56] [Sarah Cathalina-Labbe - 13-04-2026 18:58]
